title: Move free space reserves out of advanced settings
summary: Reclassified scratch and output free-space reserve settings as standard path-safety metadata so their structured builder controls render without the Settings advanced-controls disclosure.
reason: Operators can understand and safely adjust scratch/output free-space reserves during normal setup; hiding them behind advanced controls made routine disk-safety tuning harder to discover.
behavior_before: MinFreeSpaceGB and OutsourceMinFreeSpaceGB lived in Advanced/Safety metadata, so the shared Settings metadata sync classified their File Safety controls as advanced and collapsed them behind Show advanced controls.
behavior_after: MinFreeSpaceGB and OutsourceMinFreeSpaceGB live in Basic path-safety metadata with the same persisted keys, labels, defaults, and backend validation, and their File Safety controls stay visible by default.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_settings_workspace.py asserts both free-space reserve fields have standard metadata visibility.
tests/webview/test_webview_browser_settings_launch_smoke.py asserts both File Safety reserve controls render without the settings advanced toggle.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -c "from mediapipeline.core.config.metadata_parts.field_definitions import CONFIG_FIELD_DEFINITIONS; ..." (confirmed both reserve fields report advanced_visibility=standard).

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only because six unrelated dirty files are not listed in any unreleased packet.
rollback_plan: Move MinFreeSpaceGB and OutsourceMinFreeSpaceGB back from BASIC_PATH_BEHAVIOR_FIELDS to ADVANCED_CONFIG_FIELD_DEFINITIONS and revert the two visibility assertions.
notes:

Asserted free-space reserve controls render without the settings advanced toggle.
